name: Rula
short_description: Rula provider platform offers fast credentialing, high reimbursement rates, and weekly payments for therapists and psychiatrists.
long_description: Rula (formerly Path Mental Health) is a provider enablement platform that helps therapists and psychiatrists build insurance-based practices. The platform handles credentialing, billing, and patient matching, claiming faster credentialing times and higher reimbursement rates than competitors. Rula supports both therapists and psychiatric prescribers with e-prescribing capabilities for controlled and non-controlled medications. Providers receive weekly direct deposit payments and work as independent contractors. Rula is in-network with major insurers including Optum, Cigna, Aetna, Anthem, and various Blue Cross Blue Shield plans.
one_liner: Provider platform with fast credentialing, high reimbursement rates, and e-prescribing for psychiatrists.
best_for: Patients seeking in-network virtual therapy with specific specialty needs
Therapists wanting to join a fast-growing insurance-based platform
Employers seeking virtual mental health partnerships with specialty coverage
Health plans wanting to expand mental health network capacity
Individuals with Optum, Cigna, Aetna, Anthem, or Blues insurance
